g.text: SIH 2026 | PS ID: 26039 | HARDWARE RESCUE PLATFORM
AI-Driven, Communication-Resilient Autonomous Mine Rescue Platform | Safety-Governed Bounded Autonomy
• 5V Clean logic rail for Pi5 & sensors
• Enforces hard stop on gas burst
• Toxic gas treated as high cost wall
• Reverses back to last known radio link
• Shuts off high-draw sensors when idle
• Handles motor stall on steep rocks
• Drops repeater nodes at tunnel bends
• Extends wireless link deep into mine
SURFACE RESCUE TEAM DASHBOARD & BASE STATION
“Communicate & Rescue — AI Assists Detection, Rescue Team Makes Final Decision”
Real-time tunnel grid with colorized hazard overlays
Integrated RGB stream with thermal IR overlay
Breadcrumb node link status & RSSI telemetry
Timestamped victim location pins & posture state
